items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Badal starts with me with McLaughlin with My Goal’s Beyond. Then he goes with me On the Corner. He’s in the band when I start with Miles.

ctx.x: He knew me. He knew me from Elvin and Miles. Guys know you, because you’re on the scene. But we had a good time.

That’s the Indian thing. That’s Badal. Here, now, Badal starts with me with McLaughlin with My Goal’s Beyond. Then he goes with me On the Corner. He’s in the band when I start with Miles. He was in the first three or four months before he let the sitar – and he let Hal Williams go. He let organ go. That was when I joined. Indian music. Look, it’s . . .
